sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Dawley Town on Saturday 31 October (14:00 KO) looking to bounce back from their recent loss. With 31 points from 14 games, Sandbach sit top of the table despite that setback and will be keen to extend their dominance. They then host Telford Town at home on Saturday 7 November (15:00 KO), continuing their bid to maintain their commanding position.
divisionWide: Several key fixtures punctuate the weekend action. AFC Bridgnorth (second place, 27 points) travel to Stafford Town on 7 November, a clash between two of the division's stronger sides. Third-placed Bilston Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads on 7 November in a meeting of mid-table sides. At the foot of the table, Widnes Town (sixth from bottom, 6 points) face Alsager Town (second from bottom, 7 points) on 31 October at The Marine Travel Arena in what amounts to a basement battle; Widnes then travel to Alsager the following week on 7 November, creating an immediate rematch. Telford Town (bottom, 7 points) host Sandbach on 7 November. On 31 October, Wolverhampton Casuals (in-form, 25 points) entertain Allscott Heath, while Eccleshall—unbeaten in recent weeks—visit Shawbury United. Foley Meir face Barnton, Crewe travel to Dawley Town, and several other midtable fixtures (Market Drayton Town v Crewe, New Mills v Wednesfield Community, Stafford Town v Telford Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads v Brereton Social) round out Saturday's programme. The 7 November slate features additional meetings: Brereton Social host Shawbury United, Eccleshall face New Mills, Crewe visit Dawley Town, Allscott Heath entertain Wednesfield Community, Barnton host Market Drayton Town, and Wolverhampton Casuals face Foley Meir.
